name: Pass-the-Hash Auto-Containment
description: Automated containment playbook triggered by T1550 Pass-the-Hash detection. Enriches, notifies, and disables the compromised account.

trigger.description: Receives alert payload from SIEM when T1550 Sigma rule fires

steps.name: Receive SIEM Alert
steps.description: Webhook receives JSON payload from SIEM containing alert details

steps.name: Enrich Source IP — VirusTotal
steps.description: Check source IP reputation against VirusTotal threat intel

steps.name: Notify SOC — Slack Webhook
steps.description: Send enriched alert summary to SOC notification channel

steps.name: Simulate Account Disable
steps.description: POST to identity provider API to disable the compromised account. In production this targets your AD/Okta/Azure AD management API. Here it targets a mock endpoint for safe demonstration.
steps.note: Replace YOUR_MOCK_AD_ENDPOINT with webhook.site for live demo, or your real IdP API in production

steps.name: Log Containment Action
steps.description: Record all actions taken for audit trail

notes: All API keys and webhook URLs are placeholders — never commit real credentials.
